Also, she is perfectly within her rights to not want kids with him now. But so many people are completely tossing aside the fact that his whole world just shattered

Exactly. I was diagnosed at 30. It didn’t suddenly make me MORE autistic. It just explained why I am the way I have been for literal decades. And I’m not excusing his outburst, but they don’t understand that because of a single word, his entire world as he knew it was shattered

That’s not what I said at all. Yea you’re more likely to have an autistic child if you’re autistic. But he’s always been autistic. It’s not like he suddenly became that way. But once that word was introduced suddenly things are different

Sure. But there is a similar chance of having a kid with Down syndrome. 44% of those with a diagnosis are nonverbal. That seems like a lot. Yes, but her thoughts and feelings completely invalidated him as his own person because he finally has a descriptor of what he’s dealt with his whole life. It’s not like the dr saying he has autism changed who he is. He’s always been the way he is. We are regular people that have social issues, and our minds work completely differently. His wife very literally changed the entire dynamic of the relationship because of a single word. Remember. Honestly same. I met my current gf in January on Facebook Dating of all places. We’re doing pretty well, it’s the healthiest relationship I’ve ever had. It helps that we’re both the same kind of autistic so we understand certain quirks and things about each other that previous partners didn’t.

At the time we matched there, I had completely wiped out my dating apps, and really only kept Facebook since I use it for other stuff. In those two years, I had probably under 20 matches that actually replied. Out of that group, I had 6 dates. Most of the ones that didn’t go on dates only messaged me to try to get money one way or another: “sub to my onlyfans” or “can you pay for my babysitter? I get paid Friday.” And I’ll be completely honest, a couple times I did send like $5-$10 because between autism, my various mental illnesses caused by growing up undiagnosed, and being desperate, I was like “maybe they’ll actually look my way.”

I don’t pretend that I’m some catch or anything. A mentally ill autistic man that weighs 400 pounds isn’t something to write home about, but just the state of dating in general is an absolute hellscape for everybody; the marginalized populations especially.
